Description: These rat-like people, once thought to be lost to time, were in truth living amidst the ruins of Ronka beneath the great falls in Rak'tika. Their average lifespan of a mere twenty-five summers is the reason for their meticulous recording of all they learn in life, that it may be passed on to future generations. The Ronkans too noted this predilection for record-keeping, and so welcomed them as stewards in the royal court.
